oracle.sourceEvidence: main.js1694–1830 promises hiding injected macOS items while preserving ordinary Edit roles. Actual declared Electron43.7.6 original leaves foreign NSMenu item visible (UPSTREAM277 separately characterizes this); original Electron44.5.1 can exit SIGSEGV on book/menu rebuild. Candidate TypeScript live-menu implementation must satisfy actual filtering and native Copy responsiveness. Passing original safety-copy action is supporting evidence, not foreign-filter parity.

baselineDefectCases.title: [UPSTREAM277] original: declared runtime leaves foreign AppKit item visible without process crash

platformQualifications: Actual isolated AppKit menu insertion is tested; physical macOS Writing Tools service invocation and additional macOS releases are unexercised.

driverActions: Open a real stored book with nativeMenu enabled, copy Alpha through native Copy, change Body Font to Jost, insert a real foreign AppKit menu item, type Still writing and reopen.
assertions: Native Copy yields Alpha; Jost is selected; inserted foreign item is hidden; exact prose persists across leaving/reopening; Electron signalCode remains null.
